newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa says Q3 sales rose to 424,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa says Q3 sales rose to 424,000 tonnes.

text.p: Steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) domestic sales for the third quarter were 424,000 tonnes, up 55 percent in year-on-year volume terms, a company executive told Reuters on Wednesday.

"Our total sales volumes increased (in the third quarter of 1996, compared to the same period in 1995), and domestic sales increased 55 percent," said Enrique Gasca Neri, marketing director at Ahmsa's holding company, Grupo Acerero del Norte.

Gasca added that Ahmsa's total third quarter volume sales were 711,000 tonnes, or 13.4 percent up from year-ago figures. Exports, at 186,000 tonnes, were meanwhile down 42.6 percent in year-ago terms.
Gasca estimated that exports for 1996 would total about 850,000 tonnes, and said that margins were beginning to improve on export sales.
International prices were improving, he said, for hot and cold-rolled steel, galvanized sheet and slabs.
Gasca also said that if GAN should win the privatization bid for Venezuelan Siderurgica del Orinoco (Sidor), they would focus on the domestic market.
"Sidor has traditionally been an exporter, but the (Venezuelan) domestic market is recovering," he said.
